known_gaps: Catalogs are synthetic content; desktop drawn surfaces require human review
Hyprland reports no z-order: the witness orders surfaces by Hyprland's fixed drawing order and decides a point under Omarchy's span-the-output bar or notification layer by the window's own pixels
xdg popups are not listed by Hyprland: a popup is placed by the coordinates xdg_popup.configure gave its client, relative to its one parent toplevel

focus.reason: Hyprland's IPC (j/clients, j/layers, j/monitors, j/activewindow on its request socket) gives every window's address, pid, geometry and the focused window; a point under a shell layer surface is decided by the target's own pixels

notifications.reason: Omarchy's notification cards are drawn by quickshell on a layer surface and export nothing to AT-SPI: a drawn banner is read on screen (tesseract) in the top-right card column

compositor.stage: none: read-only requests on Hyprland's request socket per observation; grim (in the golden) for pixel decisions

evidence.note: Live/sensitive frames: banner areas of this desktop's notification server (top and bottom positions) are always masked; in declared desktop frames non-owned windows other than browsers and the shell's own processes are masked, browser chrome is masked from live window geometry, and window-list panels only when a window title carries a link or registered value.

consent.reason: Hyprland records through ext-image-copy-capture on put.gd's own connection; the ScreenCast portal and its share picker are never used
